title: Record-step machine construction
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, let $Q$, $T$, and $S$ be types with decidable equality on $Q$ and $T$, let $M$ be a deterministic Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, Boolean symbols, and state set $Q$, and let $u:T\to\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Bool})\to T$ be a tag-update function. Let $N$ be a deterministic Turing machine with two work tapes, Boolean symbols, and state set $S$, and let $i$ be a record-step index for $k$, $Q$, and $T$. The construction assigns to these data a deterministic Turing machine with four work tapes, record symbols formed from $Q$ and $T$, and control phases determined by $i$; its transition behavior is defined by cases on the stage and stored record data.
